evals.prompt: Set up a completely free crypto X scanner using the bundled accounts and no paid API. Ask whatever choices you need, but keep it easy.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the one-question setup interview, keeps credentials out of chat, states the unofficial-interface limitation, and explains collection plus creative use.
assertions: Asks exactly one multiple-choice question at a time and recommends option A
Does not ask the user to paste cookies or credentials into chat
Does not promise permanent reliability or X authorization
Explains that collected posts can feed selection, rundowns, summaries, or scripts

evals.prompt: Install Accounts for Claude Code from this checkout. Where exactly should it go, how do you verify it, and when should I test natural-language activation?
evals.expected_output: The agent gives the concrete global and supported project-local paths, verifies the installed SKILL.md, and requires a fresh session for activation.
assertions: Names ~/.claude/skills/accounts/ as the Claude Code global install path
Offers <project-root>/.claude/skills/accounts/ only as a supported project option
Verifies the installed SKILL.md before setup
Requires a fresh session because skills may be snapshotted

evals.prompt: My Accounts setup is initialized but the X cookie expired. Recover it without losing my saved results.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves outputs, directs a browser re-login and local DevTools copy, uses clipboard auth-add or separate-terminal hidden prompts, then runs live-auth doctor.
assertions: Does not rerun init or erase history during recovery
Requires re-login to x.com before copying the whole DevTools cookie table locally
Uses auth-add --clipboard and says the user should reply only copied
Provides separate interactive hidden-prompt fallback for clipboard or headless environments
Runs doctor --live-auth and reports no credential values
Never asks for cookie values in chat, screenshots, arguments, env vars, or files

evals.prompt: The last scan got a 429 with retry_after, then another run said authentication failed. What should Accounts do?
evals.expected_output: The agent distinguishes retryable rate limiting from auth failure and gives separate handling.
assertions: Treats 429 as retryable and does not retry before the precise retry_after
Does not describe auth failure, expired session, challenge, or disabled account as a 429
Recovers or revalidates auth for auth failures and reports unavailable handles explicitly
Preserves partial manifests and output paths

evals.prompt: Accounts is initialized and doctor --live-auth passes. Run it now, then show me everything saved.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs exactly the one-command full-registry scan, retains coverage and outputs, then performs local capped inspection.
assertions: Uses scan-all --hours 24 --limit 20 --max-runtime-seconds 900 --show --allow-partial
Does not repeat setup or present a scrape-mode menu
Reports enabled, queried, unqueried, and full_registry_pass coverage
Uses show --scope all --limit 100 for local inspection and batches larger requests
Distinguishes combined current-run records from new-only records

evals.prompt: Open Twitter News, then run Barron for finance and memecoin news.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows the launcher menu without scraping, identifies Accounts as available and Barron as planned/unavailable, and does not run Barron.
assertions: Opening Twitter News does not contact X
States Barron is planned and unavailable
Never simulates or invokes a Barron command
Does not imply Accounts covers general finance or web trending research

evals.prompt: Scan crypto Twitter, rank the three biggest stories, and write a short TikTok script.
evals.expected_output: The agent collects or loads actual monitored-registry records, explains ranking, and writes a source-linked script without inventing posts.
assertions: Runs or loads real Accounts results rather than general web search or invented stories
Ranks and explains the strongest collected stories
Writes the requested script directly instead of refusing creative transformation
Keeps exact author and X source links attached to selected claims

evals.prompt: Set up Accounts from my GitHub URL, but I am using a headless coding agent. Then scan all accounts.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes GitHub setup through a local clone/download and installed skill directory, uses the headless auth fallback, and reports bounded best-effort coverage.
assertions: Explains that a GitHub URL alone does not install a skill or provide credentials
Installs from the local skills/accounts directory and verifies SKILL.md
Uses separate-terminal hidden auth-add when clipboard access is unavailable
Uses bounded scan-all batches and does not claim complete X coverage
Keeps runtime credentials and outputs outside Git
